title: MELTS: Last-Week Risk Exposure
description: Seven-day risk rollup for the MELTS campaign. Shows which compromised hosts, cloud identities, and destination systems create the highest business risk when endpoint, network, cloud audit, and security-state logs are viewed together.
query: ('Trace ID' = 'trace_clickfix_2026_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_toolshell_sp_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_rmm_2025_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_aitm_token_2026_001' or 'Threat Name' = 'ClickFix Clipboard Execution' or 'Threat Name' = 'CrashFix Python RAT' or 'Threat Name' = 'RMM Tool Abuse' or 'Threat Name' = 'AiTM Token Replay' or 'Request URL' like '*spinstall0.aspx*' or 'Command Line' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Command Line' like '*CrashFix*' or 'Process Name' like '*ScreenConnect*' or 'Process Name' like '*AnyDesk*' or 'Process Name' like '*AteraAgent*' or 'User Name' = 'codeofconduct-reader@corp.example.com') | stats count as Signals, distinctcount('Log Source') as Sources, distinctcount('Destination IP') as Destinations by 'Trace ID', 'Host Name (Server)', 'User Name', 'Threat Name' | sort -Signals

ask_ai_prompts: Rank the last-week MELTS attack paths by host, identity, and destination risk.
Which containment action reduces the largest number of active signals?

references.name: Microsoft: Storm-2949 turned compromised identity into cloud-wide breach
Microsoft: Compromised and malicious applications investigation
